resources.string: The red color of the strawberry is due to the anthocyanins found in its plant cells.
Strawberries are the only fruit with seeds on the outside.
One strawberry has more vitamin C than an orange of the same size.

BerryCare is dedicated to providing the best plant disease detection using deep learning.

 BerryCare was created as part of the final project, which was developed by:
 - Raden Roro Nisrina Hasna Firdaus Irawati
